acceptanceCriteria: corvint-test e2e catalog over the AMAP-V0 fixture emits a deterministic e2e-block-catalog/0 document with page-object, path, outcome, input and fixture blocks, each bound to a Git blob and span, and lists STALE/UNKNOWN/inferred sources under unadmitted (CCE-V0-001, 002).

corvint-test e2e obligations maps a one-screen component diff to exactly one REACHED outcome with its reach chain, an unbounded-reach diff to UNKNOWN naming the spans, and a non-UI diff to NONE (CCE-V0-004).

corvint-test e2e compile emits one scenario for the REACHED obligation that uses only admitted block text, asserts the declared matcher/locator/value, contains no TODO, and is byte-identical on rerun with the five-value header and digest; each missing block kind yields INCOMPLETE with no emitted selector, URL or value (CCE-V0-005..007).

corvint-test e2e prove runs the scenario live with local Playwright on the fixture app: 5 head repeats pass, 5 base repeats fail on the outcome assertion's location, and both BBF-V0 controls make it fail, giving DISCRIMINATES with bound PWP receipts; an unchanged-behaviour diff gives PRESERVES (CCE-V0-008, 009).

Core corvint is unchanged: a before/after baseline shows the same commands, flags and transitive imports, no CCE package in its import graph and no init side effect in a shared package; every slice command is reachable as corvint-test e2e <sub>; the companion never executes corvint (CCE-V0-015).

The corvint-test name collisions are resolved before the binary lands: the companion-release archive classifier no longer maps a corvint-test binary to corvint-test-validity-mcp, and core `corvint test` diagnostics cannot be mistaken for the companion's (CCE-V0 Binary boundary; follow-up folding is V1-1667).
Focused tests cite each requirement ID, the CCE-V0 traceability rows for the slice move from NOT_STARTED to their evidence, and one independent review is recorded.

Closeout route (owner approved a fresh attempt on 2026-10-18): cem-verdict is granted on the anchored closeout addendum, base 86f65cd20c7fc5422b4961488a739159df5a2f00, seal eafce7d3a36d0b8a96fdf1a6b556d0d07a58680e. The delivered code maps are cited-only, so the gate checks the closeout record, not the code hunks (V1-1760, V1-1840).
body: First slice of the change-compiled E2E umbrella (owner direction 2026-10-17: augment-first; hosted blocks, generated scenarios, shadow evaluation before any hosted test is retired). Spec: docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md (CCE-V0, proposed). Binary: everything ships as the e2e group of one new experimental companion, cmd/corvint-test (corvint-test e2e catalog|obligations|compile|prove|shadow); nothing is added to core corvint (CCE-V0-015; owner 2026-10-17: "maybe it could be called corvint-test as it could cover all types of tests"). Scope: CCE-V0-001, 002, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 009 and 015 for one obligation over the committed AMAP-V0 fixture (internal/appmap/testdata/fixture); CCE-V0-003 may use one hand-written .corvint/e2e-blocks.json. Reuses AMAP-V0-013 callable page-object methods, ANL-V0 PROVEN edges, AFU-V1 declared outcomes (matcher, locator, value), PWR-V0 stability/compare and BBF-V0 wrong-locator / wrong-expected-value controls as in-module libraries. Out of scope: shadow evaluation and retirement (CCE-V0-011..013), non-Playwright runners, any selection narrowing, folding existing test companions into corvint-test.
title: Change-compiled E2E first slice: one diff compiles to one discriminating Playwright scenario on the AMAP fixture via corvint-test e2e (CCE-V0)
